verdal.title: Verdal
verdal.summary: A complete corporate website for a fictional renewable energy company, with scroll-driven animations.
verdal.description: Demo project built with Nuxt 4: ten pages with dynamic routes, typed content, animated filters, a validated form and page transitions. Animations use IntersectionObserver and CSS scroll-driven timelines, with no scroll listeners, and respect reduced-motion preferences.
highlights: Text contrast audited to AA level
Fully responsive, from phone to desktop

emptyscan.title: EmptyScan
emptyscan.summary: A modern manga reader with a Next.js front-end and a high-performance Fastify API.
emptyscan.description: A fast, smooth reading experience on the front-end, with a Fastify back-end ensuring low latency. JWT authentication, SSR/ISR, a RESTful API and image loading optimizations, focused on usability, performance and a scalable architecture.

palato.title: Palato
palato.summary: An online store with a product catalog and WhatsApp checkout integration.
palato.description: Full-stack implementation with database, JWT authentication, admin panel and form validation, ensuring security, operational control and a smooth shopping experience.
